name: Almáchar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Almáchar (a cross and a tower on green).
history: Municipal flag of Almáchar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Almáchar arms — cross and tower on green
cross, tower and crown of the arms
